data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of $258.153m. Using the gross claims development triangle, prior-year development (accident years 2017 and earlier) produced a net adverse movement of approximately $14.041m (5.44% of opening reserves), i.e. an overall strengthening of reserves. The adverse movements were concentrated in the 2017 underwriting year and were driven principally by natural catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and related Mexican earthquakes). Closed years 2009-2016 showed improvements (a reported surplus of $9.2m), but net prior-year deterioration dominated the triangle, resulting in an overall strengthening for the prior years portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: There were improvements on our closed years (2009-2016), and these years produced a surplus of US$9.2 million which contributed to both the calendar year result and the closing 2017 year result.

This year of account will close in the first half of 2020 at a loss of $35.6 million (GBP 26.6 million). The year was significantly affected by Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, as well as the two Mexican earthquakes with net ultimate claims of $41.8 million across these events.
Catastrophe losses of $15.0 million, primarily from Hurricanes Florence and Michael have contributed to the overall loss on the year.
In the calendar year there was a prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $5.1 million (2018: $5.1 million adverse).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary PYD sourced from the gross claims development triangle (page 28). Opening reserves taken from balance sheet gross claims outstanding prior-year column (page 14). The report also contains a P&L line 'claims incurred - development of prior accident years' of $5.094m which is a P&L claims-incurred figure and not the same as the prior-year reserve movement; that P&L figure was NOT used as the primary PYD source. All amounts in the statements are presented in $'000; values here have been converted to millions (divided by 1,000). Some regulatory classes show negative gross premiums (e.g. Marine, Aviation) in the segmental table - these have been included as printed. Prior year development computed by diagonal comparison excludes 2019 and 2018 as per methodology. Confidence levels reflect source reliability: triangle-derived calculations are flagged 0.8; explicit balance-sheet values 1.0.
